texts.orig: 1  Scope and Purpose
texts.text: 1  Scope and Purpose

texts.label: text
texts.orig: This specification defines the mandatory incoming inspection, electrical acceptance tests, and LED chromaticity/photometric tests required to validate every production unit of the MDIO-INPUT1 PCB assembly prior to shipment or integration into end systems.
texts.text: This specification defines the mandatory incoming inspection, electrical acceptance tests, and LED chromaticity/photometric tests required to validate every production unit of the MDIO-INPUT1 PCB assembly prior to shipment or integration into end systems.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The MDIO-INPUT1 is a 16-channel, 24 V DC digital input module intended for use in industrial automation and process-control environments. Its primary function is to receive field-side digital signals in the 24 V range, provide galvanic isolation via quad optocouplers, and report the logic states over a standard I²C bus using a PCF8575 16bit port expander. Two physical I²C connection options (pin header and flat cable/IDC) are provided.
texts.text: The MDIO-INPUT1 is a 16-channel, 24 V DC digital input module intended for use in industrial automation and process-control environments. Its primary function is to receive field-side digital signals in the 24 V range, provide galvanic isolation via quad optocouplers, and report the logic states over a standard I²C bus using a PCF8575 16bit port expander. Two physical I²C connection options (pin header and flat cable/IDC) are provided.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (3) The optocoupler LED (LTV-844, one of four channels per package) converts the field signal to an optically isolated phototransistor output on the 5 V logic side.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (4) A 330 Ω pull-up resistor (R17-R32) connects VDD through a status LED (D1-D16) to the phototransistor collector. When the channel is active the transistor conducts, illuminating the LED and pulling the U1 port pin LOW.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (5) U1 (PCF8575) reports all 16 channel states over I²C. Active input = logic 0 on the corresponding port pin (P00-P07 for channels 1-8; P10-P17 for channels 9-16).

texts.orig: 5  Safety Requirements
texts.text: 5  Safety Requirements

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The following safety precautions are MANDATORY. Failure to observe them may result in personal injury or destruction of the DUT.
texts.text: The following safety precautions are MANDATORY. Failure to observe them may result in personal injury or destruction of the DUT.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · ESD protection: Handle DUTs only at an anti-static workstation. Wear a grounded wrist strap at all times (TE10). PCF8575 and SMD passive components are susceptible to ESD damage.
texts.text: ESD protection: Handle DUTs only at an anti-static workstation. Wear a grounded wrist strap at all times (TE10). PCF8575 and SMD passive components are susceptible to ESD damage.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Hi-Pot safety: The dielectric withstand test (ET-03) applies up to 1500 Vrms. Keep hands clear of the DUT and all leads during the test. Use safety-rated test probes with shrouded contacts (IEC 61010 Cat II minimum). Ensure the hi-pot tester (TE-03) has automatic discharge on completion.
texts.text: Hi-Pot safety: The dielectric withstand test (ET-03) applies up to 1500 Vrms. Keep hands clear of the DUT and all leads during the test. Use safety-rated test probes with shrouded contacts (IEC 61010 Cat II minimum). Ensure the hi-pot tester (TE-03) has automatic discharge on completion.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · 24 V supply: When applying 24 V field voltage (ET-06, ET-07, ET-08, ET-09), ensure the power supply current limit is set to ≤ 200 mA before connection to prevent damage in the event of a short circuit.
texts.text: 24 V supply: When applying 24 V field voltage (ET-06, ET-07, ET-08, ET-09), ensure the power supply current limit is set to ≤ 200 mA before connection to prevent damage in the event of a short circuit.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Power sequencing: Apply 5 V logic supply (TE-06) to J9 before applying 24 V field supply (TE-01) to J1/J10 inputs. Remove 24 V before removing 5 V supply.
texts.text: Power sequencing: Apply 5 V logic supply (TE-06) to J9 before applying 24 V field supply (TE-01) to J1/J10 inputs. Remove 24 V before removing 5 V supply.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Isolation barrier integrity: Never connect the 24 V field ground (COM) to the 5 V logic GND during normal functional testing. These domains are isolated by the optocouplers. Bridging them invalidates hi-pot test results and risks damaging isolation.
texts.text: Isolation barrier integrity: Never connect the 24 V field ground (COM) to the 5 V logic GND during normal functional testing. These domains are isolated by the optocouplers. Bridging them invalidates hi-pot test results and risks damaging isolation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Optical measurement: When performing LED chromaticity tests, do not look directly into lit LEDs. Use the colorimeter/spectroradiometer contact adapter. Ambient light in the measurement area must be < 1 lux during photometric measurements.
